name: Charlie MJ YouTube
build: Final v2.0.0 + YouTube Courses + All-Mode Library Profiles + Exact-ID Duplicate Protection
notes: General preserves the existing filtering/target-feed engine as the compatibility baseline.
Tech, Language Learning, Productivity and Custom intelligence are additive and opt-in.
Relevance and distraction are separate scores.
GitHub sync prepares/downloads data; packaged extension files are not silently rewritten and no unauthenticated push is claimed.
featuresAdded: Exact identity duplicate protection: channelId for channels, playlistId for playlists, videoId for videos, and videoId/playlistId for courses; title similarity is never a duplicate key.
Dedicated YouTube Courses library tab with separate database/sync/download support.
YouTube Library Add URL dialog now supports General, Tech, Language Learning, Niches and Productivity mode/profile selection.
Library profile lists automatically refresh when Tech, Language Learning or Niche profiles change.
Added Productivity, Business and Fitness/Health niche profiles to the packaged Niche database.
